name: spellkave_bind_edge_affordance
label: Bind Edge Affordance
description: Attach a place_edge_affordance to an edge that ALREADY exists (author it first via spellkave_link_places / spellkave_author_place) — closes the write_rows-only gap where a raw place_edge_affordance write validated nothing against edge_key (sk-9ll.2). Derives edge_key(s) exactly as spellkave_link_places does (from->to), validates the edge AND the affordance_template_id both already resolve (workspace, live, or the active target), then upserts by (edge_key, affordance_template_id, mode_id) — re-authoring the SAME triple REPLACES bindings_json rather than duplicating (mirrors the Rust add-place-edge-affordance patch op; ADR-0101 widened the key with mode_id). Optionally also REPLACES the edge's own inherit_movement_default flag (requires the edge already authored in THIS workspace).

from.description: place_edges.from_node_id of an edge that ALREADY exists (workspace, live, or the active target) — this call never creates one. Author it first via spellkave_link_places / spellkave_author_place.

to.description: place_edges.to_node_id of the same already-existing edge.

affordance_template_id.description: place_edge_affordance.affordance_template_id — must already resolve to an authored affordance_templates row (workspace, live, or the active target); this call does not auto-create it.

mode_id.description: place_edge_affordance.mode_id (ADR-0101 D-1, default "" — the implicit default mode). An open author-chosen id (e.g. "fly", "swim") — rows sharing one (edge_key, mode_id) AND-join (all must pass); distinct mode_ids on the SAME edge OR (the cheapest passing mode charges and supplies the long-running-move session). Upserts by (edge_key, affordance_template_id, mode_id) — the SAME template under two different mode_ids on one edge is a sibling row, not a replace.

bidirectional.description: Attach to both from->to and to->from edges (default true) — mirrors spellkave_link_places' own default. Both edges must already exist when true. Pass false to bind only the from->to direction.

inherit_movement_default.description: place_edges.inherit_movement_default (ADR-0101 D-1, schema default true) — REPLACES the flag on every already-existing edge this call targets (from->to, and to->from too when bidirectional). false means the edge owns its FULL mode set from its own place_edge_affordance rows alone (the fly-only-chasm idiom); true (or omitting this param) leaves/restores the resolved bundle/graph movement_default in play. Requires the edge to already be an authored [[place_edges]] row IN THIS WORKSPACE (not just live/target) — this is a whole-row re-author under the hood, so it needs the edge's other columns already in hand to avoid silently dropping them.

promptSnippet: Attach a place_edge_affordance to an existing edge (edge + template both FK-validated)
promptGuidelines: from/to must already form an edge (author_place / link_places first) — this call never creates one.
bidirectional:true (default) attaches to both from->to and to->from; pass false for a one-way gate.
Idempotent: re-calling with the same (from, to, affordance_template_id, mode_id) replaces bindings_json in place.
mode_id groups AND-joined rows on one edge; a distinct mode_id on the same edge is an alternative (OR) the kernel picks the cheapest passing one from.
inherit_movement_default:false detaches the edge from the bundle/graph movement_default — pair it with an explicit mode_id-tagged row (e.g. a fly-only chasm).
